comment: Repository submission policy. blockedContributors: accounts whose pull requests are closed without review. Enforced by .github/workflows/submission-policy.yml and scripts/submission-policy.mjs.

blockedContributors.reason: Maintainer decision following mass automated submission of 135 pull requests in 4 hours on 2026-11-22 (including 16 previously retired <0.2.0-0 entries). Pull requests from this account are closed without review.
